title: Hunt: The Quick Hash
story: A teammate shipped this code. Read it like an attacker and tap every risky line.

tests.label: Find every risky line, then pick the fix

hints: Look for places where outside input reaches something powerful.
socratic: Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what attack does this code allow?

why_lines.4: MD5 is very fast and has no salt, so leaked hashes are cracked in bulk.
why_lines.7: Same weak hash again, and a plain == comparison is not constant time.

fix.question: What should password storage use?
options: A slow salted hash such as scrypt, bcrypt or PBKDF2
fix.why: Slow, salted hashes make mass guessing expensive.
